text:
Alex: Kicking off a blue->green traffic shift for inference-router (router-v2). Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m soak at each step. Will keep major routes pinned to v1 for 30m if errors spike.
DeployBot: Started traffic split at 1757001234: inference-router v2 = 10%, v1 = 90%. Watch latency and 5xx.
Priya: Copying checks: 1) 95p latency on p99 2) error-rate <0.5% 3) tail-latency for streaming requests. If any breach, rollback to v1 immediately.
Sam: Heads up — session affinity for websocket sessions is sticky on v1 right now. We should set cookie TTL shorter to avoid cross-version stickiness during shift.
Jordan: Quick config snippet to update Envoy weight via CI: ```bash
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/envoy/weights \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_API' \ 
  -d '{"service":"inference-router","weights":{"v1":90,"v2":10}}'```
Priya: Got CT logs — no new 5xx in the first 5m. p99 actually down 30ms. Proceed to next step in 5m unless someone objects.
Alex: Proceeding to 50% in 5m. I'll annotate the change window in the release notes. Change window: 30m total, escalation to on-call SRE at +10m if anomaly.
DeployBot: Updating traffic split: inference-router v2 = 50%, v1 = 50% (triggered by Alex)
Oncall-SRE: Noted. I have a circuit-breaker rule ready to engage if error-rate >1% sustained for 2m: sets weight(v2)=0 and routes to v1. Command to trigger rollback: `opsctl router rollback inference-router --to v1`
Sam: Ran a quick smoke against streaming endpoints — small increase in gRPC reconnects but within threshold. Prefer to keep an eye.
Priya: Alert rule verified: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="router",status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="router"}[1m])) < 0.005` — will page if false.
Jordan: Adding note: if we hit sticky-session issues, we can enable header-based routing on the cookie to pin existing sessions to v1 only. Config path: `infra/router/route-rules/cookies.yaml`
Alex: 100% planned at +20m if no regressions. If anyone sees anything concerning DM me. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Completed rollout: inference-router v2 = 100% at 1757001299 — rollout status: SUCCESS
Priya: Monitoring shows steady metrics; marking rollout as stable. I'll update the changelog and pin the version for the release: `inference-router@v2.3.1`
Sam: Added a post-mortem checklist entry for future canaries: include websocket sticky TTL step.
Oncall-SRE: Closing loop — circuit-breaker remained idle. All good from SRE side.
Alex: Thanks all. Release notes updated and version pinned.
